content: अंशुः [अंश्-मृग˚ कु.] .²1 A ray, beam of light; चण्ड˚, घर्म˚ hot-rayed, the sun; सूर्याशुभिर्भिन्नमिवाराविन्दम् <ls>Ku. 1. 32</ls>; lustre, brilliance चण्डांशुकिरणाभाश्च हाराः <ls>Rām. 5. 9. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 9</ls>. रत्न˚, नख˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A point or end. .²3 A small or minute particle. .²4 End of a thread. .²5 A filament, especially of the Soma plant (<ab>Ved.</ab>) .²6 Garment; decoration. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a sage or of a prince. .²8 Speed, velocity (वेग). .²9 Fine thread
